description: Use this when the user asks what a dental procedure costs in the United States in general, with no state named, for one of the 12 procedures. Returns the national cash band (low / average / high, mean of the 51 state figures incl. DC), its basis (observed or estimated) and the states at both ends of the range of state averages; cosmetic procedures carry no state variation. Phrasings: "average cost of dentures in the US", "typical US cost for braces", "¿cuánto cuesta una endodoncia en Estados Unidos?", "costo promedio de carillas en EE. UU.". Do not use for: diagnosis, treatment choice, a named insurer's plan price, dentist recommendations, countries other than the US and Canada. Market research and public program data with a source URL and period on every figure; not a quote, not medical advice.

procedure.description: Procedure id. One of: exam (Exam, cleaning & X-rays), filling (Composite filling (1 tooth)), deepclean (Deep cleaning (SRP, per quadrant)), extraction (Tooth extraction), rootcanal (Root canal), allon4 (All-on-4 (per arch)), whitening (Professional teeth whitening), crown (Dental crown), veneer (Porcelain veneer (per tooth)), braces (Braces (traditional, full case)), implant (Single dental implant (complete)), dentures (Full set of dentures (both arches)).
